localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
G1 is a walk-in tent only group site and does not accommodate trailers or RVs. Groups with RVs/trailers must reserve or pay for a campsite first come first serve in the campground. Parking for eight (8) vehicles is included with your group camp rental. Additional vehicles will be charged the extra vehicle fee of $10 per night. Parking is in the parking lot located 30 feet away.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
This site is designated as a walk-in site. No vehicles are allowed at the campsite. Parking for one vehicle is located in the day-use parking lot.
